newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan June exports up 31.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Nissan June exports up 31.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Friday that its vehicle exports in June rose 31.3 percent from a year earlier to 62,857 units.
Exports in the first six months of calendar 1997 rose 21.1 percent from a year earlier to 331,954 units.
Nissan's vehicle exports rose for the tenth straight month in June due to higher exports to Asia, the Middle East, and North America.
Its exports to the United States rose 18.0 percent to 29,034 units in June, partly helped by strong demand for its new Q45 luxury sedan and QX4 luxury sport-utility vehicle, a Nissan spokesman said.
Nissan's domestic production rose for the sixth successive month in June on a year-on-year basis, helped by higher exports.

Nissan's domestic sales fell for the third straight month and its overseas production fell for the second successive month in June, reflecting lower production at its U.S. unit ahead of the start-up of production of the remodelled Altima model in July.
